contexts.text: The Canaanite and the Perizzite were then dwelling in the Land () = evils and falsities in the external man... The Perizzite = the falsity (from the hereditary evil of the mother.) Explained.
That the Perizzite = falsity from evil. Illustrated.
The Hittite, the Perizzite, and the Rephaim () = the persuasions of falsity (which are to be expelled from the Lord's Kingdom).
The Canaanite and the Perizzite () = those who are in good and truth. (Continued. See Canaanite.)

(To the place of) the Amorite and the Perizzite () = (the region occupied) by evils and the derivative falsities... The Perizzite = falsity. Explained... The second origin of falsity is the evil of the cupidities of the loves of self and of the world... This falsity is signified by the Perizzite.
And shall bring thee to the... Perizzite, etc () = when the Lord has protected against the evils and falsities which infest the Church... AC 10638.
